description: This file defines the Express.js routing for posts-related API endpoints in a Node.js backend. It includes route definitions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, publishing, unpublishing, and deleting posts, with some routes protected by authentication and admin middleware. Swagger annotations document the API schema.

methods.name: getPostBySlug
methods.description: Handler for retrieving a post by its slug.

methods.name: getPostAdmin
methods.description: Admin-only handler for retrieving a specific post by ID.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Handler for creating a new post (admin only).

methods.name: updatePost
methods.description: Handler for updating an existing post (admin only).

methods.name: publishPost
methods.description: Handler for publishing a post (admin only).

methods.name: unpublishPost
methods.description: Handler for unpublishing a post (admin only).

methods.name: deletePost
methods.description: Handler for deleting a post (admin only).
